about: DEC-0173 at the pin: the contract's fixtures/vectors/instance-facts.json, every case re-answered by instanceFacts and instanceFactsRules, findings as {code, instancePath, message} per kind (descriptor: service-descriptor, wellKnown: service-well-known, pair: service-observation; null where a document is not given), and hostile cases of this kit answered by the same functions. Written by vendor_vectors.mjs, never by hand. The contract's own description: Vectors for extensions/instance-facts/0.1 (DEC-0173, DEC-0174), written by tools/vectors/instance-facts.ts, never by hand. Each case gives a descriptor and a well-known document (null: not read). Every well-known document answers as its descriptor's service (FAC-SEM-009 reads the pair as one) unless the case names another. `read` is instanceFacts(descriptor, wellKnown): the five facts, field by field, the well-known document first; a refused value is never read, the field then read from the other document; a dashboard that requires a host's login code reads host-signin for a service that declares any fact. `findings` are FAC-SEM-180's as code and path, per kind: `descriptor` (kind service-descriptor), `wellKnown` (service-well-known) and `pair` (service-observation, `{descriptor, wellKnown}`, only what neither document alone shows), null where a document is not given.
